seo.title: About Atlaxys Consulting | Software Company in Morocco
seo.description: Atlaxys Consulting is a software development and technology consulting company based in Morocco. Who we are, how we work and what you can expect from us.

hero.title: Consulting that ends in working software.
hero.lead: Atlaxys started from a simple observation: a lot of technology advice stops at the presentation. So we built a company where the people who advise you are the people who build your system, and who stay responsible for it once it is live.

story.title: Based in Morocco. Working with clients at home and abroad.
paragraphs: Atlaxys Consulting is a software development and technology consulting company based in Morocco. We work with founders, small and medium-sized businesses and larger organisations that need software to do real work: platforms their customers use every day, tools their teams depend on, and automations that save hours of manual work each week.

Morocco is our home and a good place to build technology. Teams here are used to working across English, French and Arabic, and the time zone is close to Europe's. We work directly with Moroccan businesses, and with companies abroad that want a technical partner close to them in time zone and culture.
Every project is led by people who write code, set up hosting and take responsibility for what happens after launch. That is what we mean by consulting that ends in working software.

items.label: What we do
items.value: Software development, AI and automation, cloud and DevOps, technology consulting, and our own software products

items.label: Ways to work together
items.value: Fixed-scope projects, dedicated product teams, technical advisory

engagement.title: Three ways to work with us.
engagement.intro: Choose the option that fits where you are today. You can start with one and switch to another as your product grows.

items.title: Project
items.text: A defined result, with a written scope, milestones and a fixed or capped budget.
items.bestFor: New products, migrations and projects with clear requirements.

items.title: Product team
items.text: A dedicated Atlaxys team that works as an extension of yours, month by month, on your priorities.
items.bestFor: Products that keep evolving, where speed and continuity matter.

items.title: Advisory
items.text: Architecture reviews, technical audits and senior technical guidance (similar to a part-time CTO), a few days each month.
items.bestFor: Companies that build in-house and want an experienced outside view.

refusals.title: Things we will not do.
items: Sell you a platform you do not need.
Hide important decisions inside the code, where you cannot see them.
Keep your code, data or accounts out of your reach.
Promise deadlines we do not believe we can meet.
Deliver something we would not be comfortable running ourselves.

cta.title: Let's see if we are a good fit.
cta.text: A 30-minute conversation is usually enough to know whether we can help. If we cannot, we will tell you honestly and suggest where to look instead.
